description: Take-home pay for an employee in Belgium from a gross yearly salary in EUR, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: Income year 2026 brackets with the tax-free sum and children supplements; Municipal surcharge by commune; Marital quotient for a low-earning spouse; Special social security contribution; Expat regime (35% allowance); Meal vouchers.
